name: Sacrifa Loki
source:
He is the head of the Loki family, one of the most prestigious families in the Principality of Mephi. He is a renowned magician who is highly trusted by the head of state, and has been tasked with dealing with the Fiushia religion. He is considered an authority on magic within the country.

Even in his old age, his insatiable curiosity has not diminished. He has the temperament of a researcher who is at the forefront of encountering new magic and developing efficient magical practices. However, he is primarily interested in things related to magic, and tends to judge others based on their magical skills and knowledge.
